ios.desc:
Better habits. Better together.

Keep the small promises you make to yourself, with your favorite people in your corner. HabitLeague brings daily habits, friendly competition, personal challenges, and peaceful moments into one beautifully redesigned experience.

BUILD YOUR DAILY RHYTHM
Create habits that fit your life. Choose your schedule, check in when you follow through, and watch your small efforts add up through streaks and saved progress. Completed habits tuck away, keeping Today focused on your next step.

YOUR PEOPLE. YOUR LEAGUE.
Invite your best friend, your cousin, or your mom. Create a private league, share the journey, and follow the standings. Take it seriously. Have a little fun. Give each other a reason to keep showing up.

TAKE ON SOMETHING TOGETHER
Choose a personal challenge or join a shared challenge with your league. Mark each day complete and build momentum. When you finish, celebrate, keep going, or start a fresh round.

A LITTLE SPACE. JUST FOR YOU.
Step into Focus for meditation, manifestation, and a moment to reset. Explore cosmic visuals, ambient sound, and guided breathing exercises. Make room to slow down and return to your own rhythm.

SEE HOW FAR YOU’VE COME
Find your completion history, current and longest streaks, and weekly and monthly consistency inside Profile. Give yourself credit for the effort you’ve already made.

START SMALL
New users can keep one habit free, with daily check-ins and saved progress. Premium unlocks additional habits, Focus, guided breathing, challenge participation, and creating or joining leagues.

RETURNING TO HABITLEAGUE?
Sign in with your existing account to reconnect with your saved habits, history, leagues, and membership. Restore an existing Apple subscription through Membership & purchases.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
HabitLeague offers an auto-renewing Premium subscription. Pricing and any eligible free trial are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation or when an eligible free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before renewal. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

One small promise. One daily win. Your next chapter starts here.
